title: 28 U.S.C. § 1404 — transfer from a proper venue
shortTitle: 28 U.S.C. § 1404 — transfer from a proper venue
summary: Transfer moves litigation from one federal district to another under statutory authority. Different statutes address a convenient alternative to a proper venue, an improper venue, and coordinated pretrial proceedings.

sections.Role in the course: Transfer moves litigation from one federal district to another under statutory authority. Different statutes address a convenient alternative to a proper venue, an improper venue, and coordinated pretrial proceedings.
sections.What to examine: Identify the statute before evaluating destination and convenience. Under § 1404, examine eligibility, the relevant interests, and any valid forum clause. Under § 1406, address the defect in venue. Consider the distinct treatment of multidistrict proceedings under § 1407.
